#4218 re-review at 46e967b: the reviewer APPROVED, but the verdict was lost in delivery (BUG-2564 family). I've re-run it.
- Run 1 (deputy 2 job 7f90ea, codex): its final message and its `aida review record ... --verdict approved --sha 46e967b...` call both say APPROVED. Its only findings are the two BUG-2653 P3s, which it marks deferred.
- The ledger (PR-4218.jsonl#12) holds only the sweep_pending barrier record, which disposition_verdict reads as REQUEST_CHANGES. The completion step reported: "exited without recording a verifiable verdict (no verdict file carries the reviewer's recording grant)". So `aida review verdict` shows CHANGES REQUESTED, but nothing substantive was requested.
- Same pattern as the 07:15 p18 run. Re-run submitted: deputy 2 job 20261117T102318-a71556, same focus. The head hasn't moved.
If you'd rather rule on run 1 directly (an approval with the same deferrals), say so. Otherwise I'll report once the re-run lands.
-- integration seat
subject: #4218 re-review: drafted APPROVED, verdict lost (sweep_pending); re-run queued
